LESSON: MELODY

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Creating and Executing
Topic 1.5: Melody

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Melody
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can interesting melodies be created?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify sol-fa syllables d r m in a simple melody
2. state the qualities of a good melody as a foundation to composition
3. create short melodies using the sol-fa syllables d, r and m
4. model clay slabs with sol-fa syllables using coil and slab techniques
5. enjoy creating short melodies and modelling using clay. • roll clay into slab and cut out three rectangular pieces of three different sizes, • model so-lfa syllables (d r m) using coil technique and attach on the slabs
